options.content: ● normal  ● warning  ● alarm  ● data problem  ·  ⌀ 30-day avg  ·  yesterday = from this morning's readings  ·  ⓘ details  ·  New dashboard for review: lab values and SV30 coloured by the limits in the existing Nafal dashboards

panels.description: Normal when there is no foaming, no smell, no solids at the clarifier outlet and no floating solids (latest daily check).

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN is_aeration_tank_foaming = 'No' AND is_biomass_smell = 'No' AND is_suspended_solid_clarifier_outlet_water = 'No' AND is_solid_floating = 'No' THEN 'Normal' ELSE 'Check' END AS "Daily check" FROM user_dailycheckdata WHERE form_id IN (SELECT id FROM user_customform WHERE team_id = 18 AND is_enabled AND COALESCE(NULLIF(title_override,''),name) ILIKE 'Daily Check%') ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Daily check

panels.description: Outflow meter, latest day with a reading (normally yesterday). Design 250 m³/day.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char((SELECT max((datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Muscat')::date) FROM user_flowmeterreadingdata WHERE form_id IN (SELECT id FROM user_customform WHERE team_id = 18 AND is_enabled AND COALESCE(NULLIF(title_override,''),name) ILIKE 'Flow Meter%Out%') AND daily_flow IS NOT NULL AND datetime > now() - interval '10 days'), 'DD Mon') AS "Day", (SELECT sum(CASE WHEN is_override THEN reset_value ELSE daily_flow END) FROM user_flowmeterreadingdata WHERE form_id IN (SELECT id FROM user_customform WHERE team_id = 18 AND is_enabled AND COALESCE(NULLIF(title_override,''),name) ILIKE 'Flow Meter%Out%') AND (datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Muscat')::date = (SELECT max((datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Muscat')::date) FROM user_flowmeterreadingdata WHERE form_id IN (SELECT id FROM user_customform WHERE team_id = 18 AND is_enabled AND COALESCE(NULLIF(title_override,''),name) ILIKE 'Flow Meter%Out%') AND daily_flow IS NOT NULL AND datetime > now() - interval '10 days')) AS "Treated", 100 * (SELECT sum(CASE WHEN is_override THEN reset_value ELSE daily_flow END) FROM user_flowmeterreadingdata WHERE form_id IN (SELECT id FROM user_customform WHERE team_id = 18 AND is_enabled AND COALESCE(NULLIF(title_override,''),name) ILIKE 'Flow Meter%Out%') AND (datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Muscat')::date = (SELECT max((datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Muscat')::date) FROM user_flowmeterreadingdata WHERE form_id IN (SELECT id FROM user_customform WHERE team_id = 18 AND is_enabled AND COALESCE(NULLIF(title_override,''),name) ILIKE 'Flow Meter%Out%') AND daily_flow IS NOT NULL AND datetime > now() - interval '10 days')) / 250 AS "% of design"

STP%') AND (datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Muscat')::date = (SELECT max((datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Muscat')::date) FROM user_flowmeterreadingdata WHERE form_id IN (SELECT id FROM user_customform WHERE team_id = 18 AND is_enabled AND COALESCE(NULLIF(title_override,''),name) ILIKE 'Flow Meter%Out%') AND daily_flow IS NOT NULL AND datetime > now() - interval '10 days')), 0) AS "Latest day", (SELECT avg(p / NULLIF(f, 0)) FROM (SELECT d, (SELECT sum(CASE WHEN is_override THEN reset_value ELSE daily_power END) FROM user_powermeterreadingdata WHERE form_id IN (SELECT id FROM user_customform WHERE team_id = 18 AND is_enabled AND COALESCE(NULLIF(title_override,''),name) ILIKE 'Power Meter - STP%') AND (datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Muscat')::date = d) AS p, (SELECT sum(CASE WHEN is_override THEN reset_value ELSE daily_flow END) FROM user_flowmeterreadingdata WHERE form_id IN (SELECT id FROM user_customform WHERE team_id = 18 AND is_enabled AND COALESCE(NULLIF(title_override,''),name) ILIKE 'Flow Meter%Out%') AND (datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Muscat')::date = d) AS f FROM generate_series((SELECT max((datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Muscat')::date) FROM user_flowmeterreadingdata WHERE form_id IN (SELECT id FROM user_customform WHERE team_id = 18 AND is_enabled AND COALESCE(NULLIF(title_override,''),name) ILIKE 'Flow Meter%Out%') AND daily_flow IS NOT NULL AND datetime > now() - interval '10 days') - 29, (SELECT max((datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Muscat')::date) FROM user_flowmeterreadingdata WHERE form_id IN (SELECT id FROM user_customform WHERE team_id = 18 AND is_enabled AND COALESCE(NULLIF(title_override,''),name) ILIKE 'Flow Meter%Out%') AND daily_flow IS NOT NULL AND datetime > now() - interval '10 days'), interval '1 day') AS g(d0), LATERAL (SELECT g.d0::date AS d) x) s WHERE f > 0 AND p > 0) AS "⌀ 30 days"

panels.title: Readings entered

panels.description: Latest daily check and aeration tank SV30. SV30 normal range 400–600 mL/L (existing Nafal dashboards).

targets.rawSql: SELECT is_aeration_tank_foaming AS "Foaming", biomass_color AS "Biomass colour", is_biomass_smell AS "Biomass smell", is_suspended_solid_clarifier_outlet_water AS "Clarifier solids", is_solid_floating AS "Floating solids", (SELECT round(avg(result)) FROM user_labtestdata WHERE form_id IN (SELECT id FROM user_customform WHERE team_id = 18 AND is_enabled AND COALESCE(NULLIF(title_override,''),name) ILIKE 'Lab Test%') AND btrim(type_of_lab_test) = 'Sludge Volume' AND (time_of_sample_collection AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Muscat')::date = (SELECT max((time_of_sample_collection AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Muscat')::date) FROM user_labtestdata WHERE form_id IN (SELECT id FROM user_customform WHERE team_id = 18 AND is_enabled AND COALESCE(NULLIF(title_override,''),name) ILIKE 'Lab Test%') AND btrim(type_of_lab_test) = 'Sludge Volume' AND time_of_sample_collection > now() - interval '7 days')) AS "SV30 · aeration" FROM user_dailycheckdata WHERE form_id IN (SELECT id FROM user_customform WHERE team_id = 18 AND is_enabled AND COALESCE(NULLIF(title_override,''),name) ILIKE 'Daily Check%') ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Daily check · SV30
